titles: 연세대·인하대·서강대, 이 이름들은 도대체 어디서 왔을까?
인하대의 '하'는 왜 하와이일까? 대학 이름에 숨은 진짜 뜻
대학 이름에는 왜 사람 이름이 들어갈까? 하버드부터 인하대까지
thumbnail_texts: 매일 부른 대학 이름 / 진짜 뜻

image_concepts.A: 대학 정문 돌 간판이 조각조각 분리되며 떨어지는 장면
image_concepts.B: 놀란 표정의 학사모 학생, 뒤로 인천항 증기선과 하와이 사탕수수밭

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사. 한국 대학 정문의 화강암 명판이 가로로 갈라지며 조각들이 공중으로 떠오르는 장면.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic image of a large granite university gate nameplate at a Korean campus, split horizontally into several floating fragments drifting apart in mid-air. Bright vibrant colors with a clean light-blue sky background and high-key lighting. A warm golden glow shines from the cracks between the pieces, creating an intriguing, partially revealed composition. The plaque surface is blank stone with no letters.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 애니메. 같은 갈라지는 대학 명판을 밝은 애니메 스타일로.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Vibrant anime-style illustration of a grand Korean university stone gate whose blank nameplate is breaking into floating fragments against a bright cheerful sky. Bold clean outlines and cel-shaded lighting, with golden light beams bursting from the gaps between the pieces. Cherry-white clouds and vivid saturated tones create a mysterious, curious mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사. 학사모 쓴 한국인 졸업생이 놀란 표정, 왼쪽 뒤 1900년대 인천항 증기선, 오른쪽 뒤 하와이 사탕수수밭.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic close-up of an attractive young Korean graduate with a warm likeable face wearing a navy graduation cap, eyes wide with an exaggerated surprised expression, filling the upper frame. Behind the graduate, the left side shows an early 1900s steamship at Incheon harbor and the right side shows sunlit green sugarcane fields in Hawaii. Bright vivid colors and high-key lighting with strong rim light separating the face from the background.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 애니메. 같은 장면을 애니메 스타일로.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Vibrant anime-style illustration of a handsome Korean graduate with expressive eyes in a navy graduation cap, mouth open in exaggerated surprise, oversized face at the top of the frame. The background splits between an old steamship departing Incheon harbor on the left and bright green Hawaiian sugarcane fields under a blue sky on the right. Bold outlines, cel shading and vivid saturated colors.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드. 연세대를 연상시키는 두 개의 오래된 석조 건물이 한 지붕으로 이어지는 장면(두 학교의 통합).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic wide shot of two separate early 20th-century stone campus buildings, one Gothic-style college hall and one old red-brick hospital, being joined by a single bright glowing bridge between them. Bright clean sky, high-key lighting and vivid saturated tones. The composition is centered and symmetrical, giving a curious sense of two places becoming one.
